description: Sends the replay and offer follow-up to the registrants who watched long enough to see the offer and have not bought yet, up to 200 people. Side effect: it sends REAL email to those registrants from the host's site; nothing else changes. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Read the numbers first with wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats and name the segment size before you write, because the people who receive it cannot be un-mailed. For one email to one address use wi_send_webinar_test_email.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this segment may be mailed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_send_webinar_followup
title: Send the follow-up email to the hot but silent registrants
